title: RepSelect：基于表示选择性的鲁棒LLM遗忘方法
summary: RepSelect通过在每个更新前坍缩权重梯度的主成分，隔离遗忘集特有的表示，实现深层且鲁棒的LLM遗忘。相比基线方法，在重新学习后答案准确率降低4-50倍，且对少样本提示攻击近乎完美鲁棒。
summary_en: RepSelect isolates forget-set-specific representations by collapsing top principal components of weight gradients before each update, achieving deep and robust LLM unlearning. It reduces post-relearning answer accuracy by 4-50x over baselines and is near-perfectly robust to few-shot prompting attacks.
